name: United Kingdom (UKGC) Market Profile

bindingStandards.name: Remote gambling and software technical standards (RTS)
bindingStandards.notes: Mandatory via licence condition 2.3.1. Statutory basis: Gambling Act 2005 ss.89 and 97. Updated 2025-10-31; RTS 14 amended 2026-01-12; further changes effective 2026-06-30.

bindingStandards.name: Licence Conditions and Codes of Practice (LCCP)

minGameCycleMs.notes: HARD per-round floor for slots, not an average. Must require release and re-press of the start button; continued contact must not start a new cycle. UKGC has enforced this: Stakelogic settled at GBP 122,835 over 16 titles with cycles of 0.001-0.675s (MEDIUM). Non-slot casino games are 5000 ms under RTS 14G.

maxStakePerSpin.notes: AGE-TIERED. Player age must be resolvable at the game layer, not just a boolean adult check.

maxWinPerRound.source: RTS 3A treats maximum wins as a disclosure item only

autoplay.notes: Player must commit to each game cycle individually. Only exception is auto-posting blinds in peer-to-peer poker. NOTE: GLI-19 section 4.9.2 permits autoplay; GLI certification is therefore NOT sufficient for the UK.

turboSlamStop.notes: Turbo, quick spin and slam stop are named explicitly. Applies regardless of whether the cycle already meets 2.5s. Carve-outs: bonus/feature games requiring no additional stake, scratch-all/reveal-all, and games where inaction forfeits the stake.

featureBuy.notes: No explicit RTS prohibition found. Confirm UKGC treatment under RTS 14A, and how the GBP 5 / GBP 2 stake cap applies to a feature-buy price.

jackpots.notes: Permitted, but jackpot RTP must be disclosed.

celebrationOfNonWin.notes: No celebration of returns less than or equal to the stake. Requires the game to distinguish hit frequency from net-win frequency.

minimum.notes: No minimum, but disclosure is mandatory.

disclosure.value: RTP or chance of winning must be disclosed before the player commits

financialLimits.value: Prompted at registration and first deposit, with limit-setting as the DEFAULT and an active opt-out. Periods of 24h / 7d / 1 month; the lowest prevails. Increases only after at least 24h cooling-off plus positive confirmation; decreases immediate. Six-monthly account review prompt; annual prompt where no limits set. Limit links on homepage and deposit screens.
financialLimits.notes: The default-on with opt-out design is stricter than most markets and is a common gap in products built for other jurisdictions first.

realityChecks.value: At a customer-set frequency, must be acknowledged, and must block the next game in an autoplay sequence

elapsedTimeDisplay.value: Required; continuous elapsed time for casino

selfExclusion.notes: Near-certain but the LCCP condition page is JavaScript-rendered and the condition text was not read directly.

certification.labModel: Must use a UKGC-approved Test House from the published list
certification.notes: Framework built with UKAS. Testing includes source-code review of the RNG implementation. Games and RNG results must be filed to the Games Register before release. Annual games-testing audit and annual independent security audit required.

recentChanges.change: Statutory stake caps GBP 5 / GBP 2 in force

verificationRequired: Feature buy / bonus buy treatment under RTS 14A, and how the stake cap applies to a feature-buy price
GAMSTOP mandate confirmed against LCCP condition 3.5.5 text
consultantNotes: The UK has the most detailed technical standard and the most active enforcement. Write RTS clause numbers (8A, 12A-12E, 13A-13C, 14A-14G) directly into the requirements traceability matrix.
At least three RTS changes occurred within 15 months. Treating certification as a one-off will produce periods of non-compliance.
